Bengal CM's statement on touching Durga idols sparks controversy

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee stated that only followers of Sanatan Dharma are permitted to touch Durga idols during immersion ceremonies. This statement was made in Hooghly. The remark has drawn attention and is being discussed in relation to religious practices and cultural events.
